new_product_data.title: Fronk Footrest for Cybertruck
new_product_data.detail: The ultra hyped Tesla Cybertruck, like it or not, has a front trunk aka "Frunk" that is often used for tailgating or sitting in by people but it's awkward because there is no were to put your feet up-needs a foot rest-your storable step could be the solution for a very profitable problem. See attached pictures.
new_product_data.translation: 特斯拉 Cybertruck 前备箱（Frunk）常被用于车尾派对或坐着休息，但因为没有放脚的地方很尴尬。建议设计一个可收纳搁脚板，解决这一痛点，利润空间大。详见附图。

new_product_data.title: Ratchet tie downs
new_product_data.detail: Yall need to brand a ratchet tie down system with your logo. Even just an aftermarket net for the back with your colors and name would go well. Include nice carabiners with it too.
new_product_data.translation: 建议做一个带品牌 Logo 的棘轮捆绑带系统，再做一款车尾收纳网，印上品牌配色和 Logo，配上好看的登山扣一起卖。

new_product_data.title: Auto step wheel to wheel
new_product_data.detail: Extend what you already have. Super bad
new_product_data.translation: 全轮间自动踏板，在现有产品基础上扩展

new_product_data.title: Center Retractable bumper step
new_product_data.detail: The F150 Tremor with the pro tailgate is in need of a center retractable bumper step for easier access.
new_product_data.translation: F150 Tremor 尾门需要中央伸缩式保险杠踏板，方便进入货厢。

new_product_data.title: Rack accessory
new_product_data.detail: Rooftop/ ceiling attachment. Shelter when transporting dogs
new_product_data.translation: 车顶/车厢顶挂载附件，运输狗狗时提供遮蔽空间——可考虑与后斗卷帘盖/车顶架搭配设计

new_product_data.title: Tonneau Cover Rack
new_product_data.detail: Ladder/cargo rack for tonneau cover similar to this but for less money would be a good product line addition. Reference: Leitner Designs ACS Forged Tonneau Rack.
new_product_data.translation: 建议推出一款与后斗卷帘盖搭配使用的货架/行李架，用于搭载梯子、货物等。参考 Leitner Designs 的 ACS Forged Tonneau Rack，但做更具竞争力的定价。适合北美户外/overlanding 场景。

new_product_data.title: Shoe cleaning spot in running boards
new_product_data.detail: Cut a rectangle out in the running board. In that area make a snap-in piece made of bars running lenghway topped with stiff bristles for cleaning your shoes. Debris would fall between the bars. The bristle piece will ware out. Opportunity for repeat sales. You can adapt this for cars. Attach a C shaped roof to bottom of car. Have it powered to pivot down on door opening.
new_product_data.translation: 给电动踏板加装可拆卸的鞋底清洁刷条，泥土碎屑从缝隙漏下；刷条作为耗材可产生复购；思路也可适配汽车底盘。

new_product_data.title: Hummer H2
new_product_data.detail:
Amp Research is our only option besides cheap foreign stuff on eBay.  We have factory rock sliders with 3" tube steps bolted to them even lower. Looks ok but not ideal. 

Looking to design a bracket setup to add either cut down OEM 2013 Escalade folding steps or find a set of boards like yours and develop my own brackets to adapt them. What do you offer for bare steps/motors/wiring without adapter plates for vehicle specific install brackets? Interested in working together to make an option for Hummer H2's?

Picture added is with 3" tubes removed, rock sliders still bolted to frame. Could fabricate my own brackets to create/engineer a kit to work for Us Hummer H2 fanatics.
new_product_data.translation: 悍马H2玩家想要电动踏板方案：客户愿自己加工支架，把2013款凯迪拉克Escalade原厂折叠踏板改装到H2上，或直接购买WOLFBOX裸板+电机+线束（不带车型适配支架）自己开发安装支架。客户有原厂岩石护板+3寸圆管踏板，觉得效果一般但不理想，希望与WOLFBOX合作开发H2专用套件。

new_product_data.title: Honda Ridgeline
new_product_data.detail: Are you going to make a powered retractable cover for the Ridgeline truck bed? This is a great vehicle that is overlooked and could benefit from a powered cover.
new_product_data.translation: 本田 Ridgeline 用户希望官方推出电动后斗盖（powered retractable bed cover）——该车型被市场低估，目前只能用第三方方案。

new_product_data.title: 13-15" running boards
new_product_data.detail: I am looking at your running boards. I am building a 100% custom M715 military vehicle (Kaiser Jeep M715) and need 13-15 inch running boards adapted for a flat fender setup. M715 has a unique narrow body, your standard boards don't fit. Would love a custom-length option.
new_product_data.translation: 客户正在建造一辆 100% 定制的 M715 军用卡车，需要 13-15 英寸适配长度、用于平翼子板布局的电动踏板；M715 车身较窄，现有产品不匹配，希望提供定制长度选项。

new_product_data.title: UTV Steps
new_product_data.detail: Design steps for Polaris Expedition adv NorthStar. Two seater and four seater. Need a robust step solution for accessing the cab of these UTVs. Current aftermarket steps are flimsy and don't hold up to off-road use.
new_product_data.translation: Polaris Expedition adv NorthStar（UTV 全地形车）双座 / 四座版踏板设计需求——现有第三方踏板不够耐用，希望做越野强化版本。这是 UTV 全新车型的需求，可考虑作为新品类立项。

new_product_data.title: bumper step
new_product_data.detail:
I believe a universal bumper step for us guys with older trucks, and a DIY mentality may be a opportunity to move more units.
If there is one like that available now, I would be interested.
 If not, I would be happy to receive your product, modify in a manner that would make it more adaptable, and share the results.
My current stable includes; 1950 F1, 1974 F-350, 1979 F-250, and 2005 F-150.
The 1979 F-250 would be my first goal to add the step.
Thank you for your time, and also for bringing your products to the unwashed masses like yours truly,
Steve Scott
new_product_data.translation: 老皮卡 DIY 玩家建议开发面向老旧皮卡车型的通用保险杠踏板（bumper step）。他本人拥有 1950 F1、1974 F-350、1979 F-250、2005 F-150 四辆老车，首选改装目标是 1979 F-250。他表示若已有此类产品愿意购买；若没有，愿意购买我们的产品、自行改装适配并分享改装成果。
